02 / WHERE WE SEE AYARI TODAY

AYARI LONGEVITY already has a strong foundation. The gap is in how this translates into content.

AYARI LONGEVITY already has a strong foundation: a premium identity, credible founders, good products and a clear connection between health, beauty and longevity.

The gap we see is mainly in how this translates into content.

At the moment, a large part of the social presence relies on product-focused education and Jasmin-led UGC. This creates consistency, but it also means the audience keeps seeing the brand through a similar face, format and type of story.

We don’t think Jasmin should disappear from the content. Quite the opposite. We think her role should evolve, while AYARI starts building a much bigger world around her.

WHAT WE WANT TO CHANGE
Founder-heavy→
Multiple voices
Product explanation→
Broader stories
Similar UGC formats→
Different content formats
Supplement-focused→
Lifestyle-focused

We want AYARI to feel less like a supplement brand and more like a world people want to be part of.

03 / WHAT COULD AYARI TALK ABOUT?

Talk about how people want to live.

We don’t want to limit AYARI LONGEVITY’s content to what each supplement does. The bigger opportunity is to talk about how people want to live. The products can naturally live inside these conversations instead of always being the starting point.
BODYSleep / Nutrition / Movement / Recovery / Energy / Aging
MINDStress / Self-awareness / Mindfulness / Focus / Rest
BEAUTYSkin / Confidence / Inside-out beauty / Healthy aging
LIFEWork / Travel / Food / Relationships / Daily habits

Magnesium doesn’t always need another “5 benefits of magnesium” video.

04 / PEOPLE, NOT JUST PRODUCTS

More people.
More perspectives.

Jasmin can still be present, but with a more elevated role — as a founder, host and personality of the brand. The same applies to Ramin: his medical background can become a stronger authority layer through better formats and bigger conversations.
JASMIN

Founder / host / personality

Present in the world of AYARI LONGEVITY without carrying most of the recurring UGC.

RAMIN + GUESTS

Authority through conversation

Doctors / Experts / Creators / Chefs / Athletes / Customers / Founders / Interesting people from different lifestyles.

Why are we all tired?

How much does stress affect the way we age?

Why is knowing what is healthy not enough?

What does living well at 70 look like?

05 / MAKING LONGEVITY PART OF REAL LIFE

Put the products where life happens.

Morning routines. After Pilates. At work. During travel. Before sleep. After a stressful day. At breakfast. During recovery.

AYARI × Chef
Build a recipe or experience around the same ingredients or health topic.

AYARI Slow Morning
Breakfast, movement, mindfulness and a conversation around starting the day differently.

AYARI Sleep Dinner
Food, sleep, recovery, an expert conversation and the relevant AYARI products inside one experience.

MORNINGMOVEMENTTRAVELRECOVERY
06 / A BETTER UGC SYSTEM

Not less UGC.
Better UGC.

We are not planning to remove UGC. We want to make it more intentional. Each month, based on the content strategy, we define who should appear, what they should talk about, which product fits the story, the hook, talking points, recording style, location / context, visual references and product integration.

03 / PRODUCT

Something people can participate in.

We would gradually explore ideas that make AYARI more than something people follow. These experiences also become a natural source of photography, video, UGC, interviews and social content.

08 / HOW WE WOULD RUN IT

Strategy first.
Production second.

We don’t want to decide now that AYARI needs “X reels and X photoshoots every month.” First, we build the creative strategy. Then each month we decide what actually deserves to be made.

Production will be quoted separately. One month may only require a small shoot. Another may involve a campaign, talent, location or an event. We would rather price production around the actual idea than lock AYARI into an unnecessary monthly production package.

09 / ADDITIONAL SERVICES

Beyond organic.
When needed.

These are additional services we can provide as AYARI LONGEVITY grows. They can be added separately depending on the brand’s priorities, campaigns and growth needs.
INFLUENCER & CREATOR MARKETING

Not just sponsored posts.

Finding creators who actually fit the AYARI LONGEVITY world, developing collaboration ideas, briefing them, managing content direction and gradually building a network of recurring creators.

Product → Influencer → Sponsored Post
becomes collaborations with people who bring credibility, culture, reach, expertise or a new audience.

META & GOOGLE ADS

Creative that learns.

Paid campaigns can be managed as an additional service, including campaign setup, audience strategy, retargeting, creative testing, optimization and reporting.

Paid media can also tell us which hooks, topics, products and creative formats resonate — and feed those learnings back into content.

FUTURE OPPORTUNITIES
Email / CRMBrand PartnershipsWellness & HospitalityCreator SeedingEventsLong-term Ambassadors
10 / SCOPE & INVESTMENT

Clear scope.
One partnership.

A clear monthly creative partnership, with production and additional services kept flexible so we can scale the work around what AYARI LONGEVITY actually needs.
